say:0:1820611001:0.text: How odd... That tiger seemed to understand every word we said.
say:0:1820611001:0.source_cn: 真奇怪，那只白骨虎似乎听懂了我们说的话。
say:0:1820611001:0.male: How odd... That tiger seemed to understand every word we said.
say:0:1820611001:0.female: How odd... That tiger seemed to understand every word we said.

say:1:1820611002:0.text: There's still a cat here. Let's check on it.
say:1:1820611002:0.source_cn: 还有一只亡灵猫留在这里，姑且看看它的情况吧。
